title: Modernize Vaporize workstream process around Vaporize-first proof lanes and current executable reality
createdBy: codex via $capture after operator correction that Git/Savepoint audits must use vaporize

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: Git/Savepoint SCM audit was corrected from xcrun-swift describe as primary proof to vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test as the required proof lane.
historicalContent.description: The workstream process must align Vaporize documentation, workflow formulas, audit habits, and receipts with the installed Vaporize command surface. Current installed Vaporize supports test/build/run/pass/use/toolchain/setup/status/warehouse/validate-json/project inspection/list-targets/list-schemes/release-doctor/inventory/domains/self-update/graph. Existing workstream prose still references the older vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli spelling and the planned but not-installed realize mode. The process needs explicit modern gates so agents use Vaporize first, avoid jq and direct git proof lanes, and route persistence through savepoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize workstream docs name the installed executable as vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh.
Workflow formulas stop treating raw swift package describe, jq, or direct git status as primary proof lanes.
Every Swift package audit in this workstream has a Vaporize command line equivalent and a structured receipt expectation.
The planned realize flow is either implemented as a real Vaporize mode or clearly marked collapse-blocked behind vaporize-realize-typed-vaporware-unit.
validate-json is upgraded or documented so repeated --path behavior cannot silently validate only the last path.
SCM product-line audits have a Vaporize-first recipe covering SwiftPM packages, schema JSON validation, and native Xcode project-list exceptions.
Savepoint persistence is treated as the only forward commit primitive for assistants; direct git remains diagnostic only when operator explicitly permits it.
Simulation-dependent Vaporize tests have a deterministic CUJ-state harness derived from CUJs.
